solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Agree expert is concealing three consecutive letters

indicators.note: concealing means the expert's word hides the letters inside itself

parts.note: an ace is an expert
C, D and E are neighbours in the alphabet, here entered as C, E, D

explanation.surface: Someone admits a specialist is hiding a run of the alphabet.
explanation.walkthrough: The three neighbouring letters C, D, E sit inside ACE between its C and E, in the order C, E, D; the clue says which letters, not their order.
explanation.definitionFit: To accede is to consent or give assent to a request or proposal.

clue.text: Better to go topless for one on casual walk

indicators.note: losing the top means the first letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a better is one who bets, a gambler

explanation.surface: A punter decides to strip off for a stroll.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Better' reads as 'preferable', but it is someone who places bets.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambler is a person who strolls at a leisurely pace.

clue.text: Declare, formally, there's cheat with company

parts.note: to con is to swindle or cheat
a firm is a business company

explanation.surface: An official announcement that a swindler is in partnership.
explanation.definitionFit: To confirm is to state or ratify something officially, as in confirming an appointment.

clue.text: Dublin parliament featuring in newspaper mostly

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word, so its last letter is lopped off

parts.note: a daily is a newspaper published every day

explanation.surface: Ireland's legislature gets plenty of press coverage.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dáil is the lower house of the Irish legislature, sitting in Dublin.

clue.text: At this point and earlier commercial's getting stick

indicators.note: earlier says the commercial's letters come before the other piece

parts.note: a commercial is an ad; the 's stands for 'has' and joins
here means at this point

explanation.surface: A TV advert that ran before is now catching on with viewers.
explanation.definitionFit: To adhere is to cling or remain attached, as glue does.

clue.text: Glass container in crate Ned shifted

indicators.note: shifted means moved about, so the letters change places

explanation.surface: Ned moves a crystal bottle that was packed in a wooden box.
explanation.definitionFit: A decanter is a stoppered glass vessel for serving wine or spirits.

clue.text: Implant taken from stem? Be delicate!

indicators.note: taken from says the letters are lifted out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A surgeon's warning: be gentle when grafting tissue from a stem.
explanation.definitionFit: To embed something is to fix it firmly within surrounding material, as an implant is.

clue.text: Man's cosy home descended on by queen

indicators.note: in a down clue, being descended on puts the queen's letters on top of the home

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword queen
a nest is a snug home

explanation.surface: A monarch drops in uninvited on a man's snug house.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue the piece that descends on another sits above it, so ER goes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernest is a male given name, so it serves as an example of a man.

clue.text: Depositing anti-monarchist slogan?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: putting money into a bank account
second meaning, read as two words

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the whimsical split of the answer into BAN KING.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying money into an account is banking it; the split reading is a demand to abolish the king.

clue.text: Real soggy after replacing waterspouts!

indicators.note: replacing means putting the letters in different places, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Things get truly sodden once the drainpipes are swapped.
explanation.definitionFit: Gargoyles are carved stone spouts that throw rainwater off a building's roof.

clue.text: Hut not exactly the place for junk

parts.note: ca (circa) means approximately
rubbish goes in a bin

explanation.surface: A shed that is not really a proper home for a Chinese sailing ship.
explanation.walkthrough: Junk tempts as the Chinese boat, which suits a cabin; here it is simply rubbish, kept in a bin.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabin is a small, simple wooden dwelling, much like a hut.

clue.text: Leave around eleven, Eastern Time

indicators.note: around says the Eastern Time letters go round the number

parts.note: XI is eleven in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Instructions to depart at about eleven o'clock, east-coast time.
explanation.definitionFit: To exit is to go out or depart, the same as to leave.

clue.text: Pineapples: sad, green, withered

indicators.note: withered means shrivelled and twisted out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A greengrocer describes sorry-looking pineapples: sad, unripe and shrivelled.
explanation.walkthrough: Pineapple is old military slang for a hand grenade, from its segmented shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers' slang calls a hand bomb a pineapple because of its ridged casing.

clue.text: Rejoicing until jab is thrown

indicators.note: thrown means thrown off course or scattered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A boxer celebrates right up to the moment a punch lands.
explanation.definitionFit: Jubilant means triumphantly joyful, full of celebration.

clue.text: Quiet around gold, solitary tomb

indicators.note: around says the quiet word wraps the other letters

parts.note: mum means silent, as in 'keep mum'
Au is the chemical symbol for gold
sole means single or only

explanation.surface: A hush surrounds a lone golden burial chamber.
explanation.definitionFit: A mausoleum is a stately building housing a grave, a grand burial monument.

clue.text: Second one to leave United got on his horse?

parts.note: mo is a moment or second

indicators.note: to leave means the one-letter piece departs from the team name

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A footballer quits United and rides off.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider who has mounted has climbed up into the saddle; the question mark marks this as one example.

clue.text: Short bitter argument brings sadness

indicators.note: short means the word is cut, so its last letter goes

parts.note: sore can mean resentful or bitter
a row is a quarrel

explanation.surface: A brief, resentful quarrel leaves everyone unhappy.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorrow is deep grief or distress, much like sadness.

clue.text: Spinner initially playing in team meeting resistance

indicators.note: in means that letter goes inside the team word

parts.note: a side is a team

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the next word

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A spin bowler starts playing for a team that is struggling.
explanation.walkthrough: Spinner suggests a cricket bowler; it is the creature that spins webs.
explanation.definitionFit: A spider spins silk to build its web, so it is a natural web-maker.

clue.text: Quirky duo I left in part of sports arena?

indicators.note: quirky means odd or eccentric, so the letters are set in an unusual order

explanation.surface: An odd pair leave someone behind in a stadium.
explanation.definitionFit: The outfield is the region of a cricket or baseball ground far from the batter.

clue.text: Watch for one's authority to be overturned

indicators.note: overturned in a down clue means turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: a remit is an area of authority

explanation.surface: Someone's power is about to be struck down by a court.
explanation.definitionFit: A wristwatch is one example of a device for measuring time.

clue.text: Quit after making the last quiet, cutting remark

indicators.note: the final letter of the first word is changed into the quiet letter

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone stops talking after a sharp jibe.
explanation.definitionFit: A quip is a witty or sarcastic comment, often a barbed one.

clue.text: Zulu idol losing his first love

parts.note: Z is Zulu in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: the first letter of the idol's word is dropped

parts.note: a hero is an idol

explanation.surface: A Zulu idol loses his first romantic partner.
explanation.walkthrough: Love is the tennis score of nil.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis scoring, love means nil, no points at all.

clue.text: Rare, bishop going to a dance

parts.note: rum is old British slang for odd or rare
B is the chess notation abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: An unusual sight: a clergyman heading off to a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: The rumba is a Cuban ballroom style with lively hip movements.

clue.text: Small coin journalist sniffed out

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
a cent is a small coin
ed, short for editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter tracks down a tiny coin, like a bloodhound on the scent.
explanation.definitionFit: To have scented something is to have detected it by smell, as hounds do.

clue.text: Swarm that's somewhat reduced in heat

indicators.note: somewhat reduced says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A bee swarm shrinks as the weather gets hot.
explanation.definitionFit: Warmth is a moderate degree of heat, a near synonym.

clue.text: That Rodney, fooling about!

indicators.note: fooling about means messing around, so the name's letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: An exasperated remark about a man named Rodney clowning around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That' looks like a throwaway pointer to Rodney but it is the definition: yonder can mean 'that over there', as in 'yonder hill'.
explanation.definitionFit: As an old-fashioned determiner, yonder points to something distant, meaning that over there.
